# RedundantElseClause

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Control flow](/rules/#control-flow) · PhpStorm name: `RedundantElseClauseInspection`

When an `if` body always leaves the current flow (return, throw, break,
continue, exit/die), the following `else`/`elseif` keyword is superfluous: its
code can simply follow the `if`. Removing it flattens nesting.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{3,5,7,10} [Before]
<?php
function route($req, $list) {
    if ($req === null) { exit(3); } else { ; }
    if (!$list) { throw new LogicException('none'); }
    else { ; }
    foreach ($list as $item) {
        if ($item < 0) { continue; } else if ($item > 9) { break; }
    }
    if ($req === 'a') { return 1; }
    elseif ($req === 'b') { $list = []; } else { $list = [1]; }
    if ($req === 'c') { $list[] = 2; } else { ; }
    if ($req === 'd') return 4; else ;
    if ($req === 'e') { return 5; } else $list = [];
    if ($req === 'f') { ; } else if ($req === 'g') { return 6; } else { ; }
    if ($req === 'h'):
        return 7;
    else:
        $list = null;
    endif;
    return $list;
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function route($req, $list) {
    if ($req === null) { exit(3); };
    if (!$list) { throw new LogicException('none'); };
    foreach ($list as $item) {
        if ($item < 0) { continue; }
        if ($item > 9) { break; }
    }
    if ($req === 'a') { return 1; }
    if ($req === 'b') { $list = []; } else { $list = [1]; }
    if ($req === 'c') { $list[] = 2; } else { ; }
    if ($req === 'd') return 4; else ;
    if ($req === 'e') { return 5; } else $list = [];
    if ($req === 'f') { ; } else if ($req === 'g') { return 6; } else { ; }
    if ($req === 'h'):
        return 7;
    else:
        $list = null;
    endif;
    return $list;
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: Drop the &#39;else&#39; and move its code after the &#39;if&#39;.</li>
<li>line 5: Drop the &#39;else&#39; and move its code after the &#39;if&#39;.</li>
<li>line 7: Drop the &#39;else&#39; and move its code after the &#39;if&#39;.</li>
<li>line 10: Turn this &#39;elseif&#39; into a separate &#39;if&#39;.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "RedundantElseClause": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore RedundantElseClause

/**
 * @noinspection RedundantElseClauseInspection
 */
```
